fact: After the biometric and administrative census of public agents, the information collected was cross-checked with payroll data and with the data of the Direction générale de la documentation et de l'immigration (DGDI) to establish the situation of agents not found, leading to 1,473 removals from 1,765 files examined.
title: Gabon/Fonction publique : l'opération d'assainissement du fichier solde livre ses conclusions
